integrity: All theoretical claims are deduced from an elementary colored-component decomposition; verification computations are independent finite corroborations. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only partial bijections satisfying the exact square-zero factor condition are considered.
The enumerative conclusion concerns ordered pairs and their literal composition product, not unordered pairs or other transformations.
Comparisons with the two inspected primary preprints and research-index results cannot establish worldwide uniqueness.
Exhaustive checks through seven points corroborate, rather than prove, arbitrary-size identities.
title: Product fibers and rank gaps for commuting square-zero partial bijections
